notes.notes:

notes.title: RELEASE DATE - HAELE 3D - Portrait Studio Lite
notes.notes:
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44505409/e86e111e19586fb77c96cb2ffc53891c6cfd9b61.png

HAELE 3D - Portrait Studio Lite is going to release on: 26 August 2024

It is going to be a completely free facial reference application for artists.

Wishlist Now to get notified on the release!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2949950/HAELE_3D__Portrait_Studio_Lite__Drawing_References/

HAELE 3D - Portrait Studio Lite is a comprehensive 3D facial anatomy drawing reference tool designed for artists. With a diverse range of characters, expressions, and environments, it serves as an invaluable resource for learning how to draw faces. Easy to navigate and use, this app complements tutorials and aids beginners in perfecting their portrait drawing skills

notes.title: 1.0 RELEASE - Feet Poser Pro
notes.notes:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44505409/f0c176898b43c6880d1aee73135cd4d719649d2d.png

Dear Guys! 

HAELE 3D - Feet Poser Pro has reached a state in which I believe it is ready to leave Early Access and continue it's life as a full release! 

It is so much more than I ever believed it's gonna be, thanks to your invaluable feedback and support! 🙏

Thank you so much everybody for all of your input and kind words! They mean so much! 🙏💛
Feet Poser Pro is going to release into 1.0 this Friday! 

You can help to reach as many people as possible by Wishlisting it on Steam and with likes and RTs. 
https://x.com/igeolwen/status/1777728714391859205

Thank you again! 🥰

aand I have updated the trailer as well with some new shots if you haven't seen it yet check it out: 

https://youtu.be/JwYZ254jpiY?si=kEub536PutHV4w5b
